title: danthonia pallida
intro: Danthonia pallida, commonly known as Blue Wildrye or Pale Blue Oat Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Danthonia pallida include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
